intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Phuket to Krabi? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: From Phuket to Phi Phi you take a boat mainly from Rassada Pier. The ferry takes about 2 hours; a speedboat is faster at around 1 hour but bumpier. For a day visit, most people book a day tour that includes hotel pickup.

rows: Smoother; good for sea-sickness or staying over

blocks.html: If you are staying overnight on Phi Phi Don, the ferry is smoother and easier with luggage. For a day visit hitting several spots, a speedboat day tour with hotel pickup and snorkel gear is good value and saves you arranging anything yourself.

faq.q: How long is the boat from Phuket to Phi Phi?
faq.a: About 2 hours by ferry and around 1 hour by speedboat, mostly departing from Rassada Pier on the east side of Phuket.

faq.q: Should I visit Phi Phi as a day trip or stay overnight?
faq.a: A day trip suits short schedules and ticking off highlights like Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. Staying overnight on Phi Phi Don suits a slower pace, sunrise and sunset, and escaping the midday tour crowds.
